title: Smooth Stick Aim
description: Analog stick aiming that keeps the direction you push: a round dead zone instead of a square one, the same reach in every direction, and no crosshair drag when you let go of the stick. Settings in Options > Gamepad: Far Crosshair (on: the crosshair stays at full distance and the camera looks ahead while you aim; off: like the base game), Stick Dead Zone (8%), Fine Aim (50%: slow stick turns move the aim half as far, for small adjustments) and Aim Speed (300%: the crosshair follows the stick almost at once; 100% = base game). Made for handhelds like the AYN Thor; works with any controller.
